name: Quell the Silverwing Usurpers
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 2,750 experience instead of 3,300, 0.83 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The wilds of the Ashenvale forest will succumb to the might of the Horde, friend. Nothing the Silverwing say or do can stop our sovereign imperative. Kalimdor belongs to the Horde. How dare they attempt to prevent us from harvesting what is rightfully ours!

Let the pride swell in your chest as you cut down their weak attempts at slowing our progress. Destroy the Silverwing Sentinels, and earn a Warsong mark of honor.  Return to me with such a mark, adventurer, and you will be rewarded.
narrative.objectives: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Alliance, gain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and bring it to Captain Shatterskull at the Mor'shan Base Camp.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Captain Shatterskull roars in triumph.>How much more can they withstand? How many more Alliance filth must perish at the hands of the Horde for them to retreat? Only time will tell, friend.
narrative.requestItemsText: The blood of our enemies is a mark of honor. Do you have such a mark?
